subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For replay-unsafe stop/tool-call empty turns with tools>0 and payloads=0, should OpenClaw add a safe retry/fallback path, persist a durable quarantine/repair record, or keep the current fail-closed behavior with better diagnostics?
rationale: The current fail-closed path protects side-effect safety, but field evidence shows it converts provider flakes into recurring user-visible failures; choosing the recovery boundary is a runtime safety/product decision.

options.title: Approve scoped recovery plus quarantine
options.body: Allow retries or model fallback only when current-attempt side effects are proven absent, and persist explicit quarantine/repair state for unsafe incomplete attempts.

options.title: Keep fail-closed and improve diagnostics
options.body: Preserve the current no-retry behavior for replay-unsafe attempts and add clearer incident/logging surfaces so operators can diagnose and recover manually.

options.title: Fold into the broader canonical issue
options.body: Treat the remaining policy as owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657 and close this issue only after its unique cron/quarantine evidence is preserved there.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped recovery plus quarantine
recommendation.body: Allow retries or model fallback only when current-attempt side effects are proven absent, and persist explicit quarantine/repair state for unsafe incomplete attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the adjacent replay-safety PRs and is the strongest available routing candidate for the maintainer policy choice.
